name: Seecamping Wimmer
beschreibung: The Seecamping Wimmer is located in Maurach on the Achensee in Tirol, Österreich. The surroundings are characterized by mountains and natural landscapes. Nearby are ski areas for winter operations and a network of hiking trails for summer. The campsite has pitches for tents and motorhomes as well as sanitary facilities with showers and toilets. Guests find a quiet atmosphere that is suitable for relaxation and sports activities. The location offers direct access to the lake for water sports opportunities.
